|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The Virtual Block 6.1 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image on this page show this text. No published image shows the errata text; [[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata)]] uses a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB6-51-Weapon_Levitation_The_Empires_Back-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the first copy of the Virtual Block 6.1 (Reflections IV) release sheet and the revised Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet (official text as of 4 September 2009): “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Wookiee Strangle. OR Once per battle involving Vader, reveal a device or character weapon from Used Pile and add its printed destiny number to your total power; reshuffle. LOST: Use 1 Force to ▼ (or retrieve) Vader. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Vader defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.”.<ref name="sheet-6_1-first">Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV sheet, first copy ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; attachment Block6WithRebelFleetV.pdf, [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1375528 Players Committee forum])</ref><ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Virtual Block 6.1 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 4, 2009"; revised copy, PDF dated 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again (Dark Side, p. 40). That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Weapon Levitation & The Empire's Back (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spells “Wookiee” as “Wookie” (it also writes ▼ out as “deploy … from Reserve Deck; reshuffle” and runs “reshuffle.LOST” together, which is notation only): “USED: Cancel Disarmed or Wookie Strangle. OR Once per battle involving Vader, reveal a device or character weapon from Used Pile and add its printed destiny number to your total power; reshuffle.LOST: Use 1 Force to deploy (or retrieve) Vader from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If opponent just initiated a battle against Vader defending alone at a site, his forfeit cannot be reduced.”.<ref name="cl-1261_48-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock6Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064737/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-07-21], [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212001607/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2012-12-12] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142254/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive); the Virtual master list (VMasterType) shows the same text from 2012-07-21 to 2013-01-11</ref>
